title: Archive through April 10, 2003 - Anonymous (Saturday, March 15, 2003 - 01:07 pm)
content: I used to have a lot of migraine headaches (which stopped after this experience). I was at my parent’s house. I had taken some medication for my migraine, and because of this I was staying at my parents. I just lit up a cigarette.... And..... Went out! I found myself in a place that was devoid of everything except, a doorway of white/gold light. I had a consciousness, no body, and could see all around at once. I moved, thought to go towards the doorway of light, which by the way was as large as the darkness around it (I cant think of another way to describe this) and as I approached this doorway another Light became apparent just before the doorway. It was like a welcome mat of sorts. I had a sense of beginning to pass over the mat, almost into the doorway when, I heard from a great distance away my name “Geeoorrgggeee”. I recognized the name and the moment I did, I was racing at a breath-taking speed through the darkness. It felt almost like I was going backwards, towards and into another space/time and, found myself cracking back into my body through the top of my head. I sat bolt upright, knowing already who and where everyone in the room was, there were 2 paramedics and my parents. My first response was to tell my mother everything was ok now. I was sooo at peace, it was such a profound peace that I cant describe it except that it was all Loving. I was told that once my father got me breathing again, I was "out" for another 20-30 minutes. The paramedics continued giving me oxygen and at first I didn’t want to go to the hospital, but couldn’t sign my name on the form, so I ended up going for about 15 minutes, until with the help from the oxygen I was clear headed. The Peace I felt was so profound I wish I could explain it and even share it with others. As well for the next 6 months or so I was getting different revelations at a rate of about one per week. The revelations slowly went away after about 2 years and also I had no fear of death since. And, no more migraine headaches since. Although, now I do have sinus headaches. Oh as well, sometime after I had for about a 3 weeks span, maybe more, a number of instances where I thought my head was going to explode. At times it was so intense I had to drop to the floor with my hands on my head in a vain effort to hold it in, so it wouldn’t explode. Umm I think that’s about it, there may be more but, that’s all I can remember right now. The Peace I felt, man I wish we all could feel it!!!!

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Profound peace described as 'all Loving'; had 'a consciousness, no body'.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: A place 'devoid of everything' except a doorway of white/gold light; later raced through darkness at breath-taking speed back to body.
tunnel.movement_other_detail: Felt 'almost like I was going backwards, towards and into another space/time' while returning.

environment.environment_other_detail: Darkness/void with a 'doorway of white/gold light' and another light 'like a welcome mat of sorts' before the doorway.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Collapsed ('Went out!') at parents' house after taking migraine medication and smoking a cigarette; father got him breathing again; paramedics gave oxygen.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: He heard his name called from a distance and immediately returned rapidly, 'cracking back into my body through the top of my head.'
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Void/darkness with a doorway of light functioned as the boundary; return triggered by hearing his name rather than a being/light interaction.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: A second light before the doorway described as a 'welcome mat'; return sensation of re-entering through the top of the head; post-NDE weekly 'revelations' for ~6 months that faded after ~2 years; migraines stopped after the experience.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I found myself in a place that was devoid of everything except, a doorway of white/gold light.” “I had a consciousness, no body, and could see all around at once.” “It was like a welcome mat of sorts.” “I was racing at a breath-taking speed through the darkness.” “found myself cracking back into my body through the top of my head.” “I was sooo at peace… it was all Loving.”
